subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should the canonical fix bound Skill Workshop lifecycle approval below the Codex dynamic-tool watchdog, or extend the outer watchdog/approval contract for Skill Workshop actions?
rationale: Both approaches affect the approval security boundary and user-visible lifecycle semantics, and open PRs already encode competing choices.

options.title: Land the bounded-approval fix
options.body: Revise or land #100498 so Skill Workshop approval expires before the dynamic-tool wrapper and returns a clear pending/timeout result with metadata.

options.title: Extend the dynamic-tool watchdog
options.body: Use a #91325-style outer-timeout increase and prove approval expiry, side-thread behavior, and operator denial semantics stay consistent.

options.title: Accept the contributor-only timeout bump
options.body: Proceed with #94315's longer apply TTL only if maintainers intentionally accept the remaining Codex watchdog mismatch and narrower action coverage.

recommendation.title: Land the bounded-approval fix
recommendation.body: Revise or land #100498 so Skill Workshop approval expires before the dynamic-tool wrapper and returns a clear pending/timeout result with metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on the issue and owns the open maintainer-authored closing PR for the canonical fix.
